title: TSRP Update
summary: Tickets now close automatically when the person who opened them leaves the server.

sections.heading: Ticket Cleanup
items: If someone leaves the server while they still have an open ticket, it's now automatically closed for them.
The closure works exactly like a normal ticket close -- a full transcript is saved and the usual logs are posted, with the reason recorded as "User left the server."

title: TSRP Update
summary: Fixed a bug that could cause startup announcements and info panels to post multiple times instead of once.

sections.heading: Bug Fix: Duplicate Announcements & Panels
items: Fixed a bug where running /startup could post the online announcement, and ping @everyone, more than once instead of exactly once.
Fixed persistent info panels (like Guidelines, Booster Perks, and the Department Hub) sometimes posting a brand new duplicate message instead of updating the existing one.
Both issues came from the same underlying cause, which is now fixed at the source rather than papered over.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A brand new stock market, plus storefronts and a server-wide lottery -- new ways to earn, invest, and spend your money.

sections.heading: New: Stock Market
items: Added a full stock market to the economy -- buy and sell shares of different companies, right from Discord.
Every stock has its own price, description, industry, and history -- check daily, weekly, and monthly performance before you buy.
Prices move on their own over time, and your own buying and selling nudges the price too -- it's a living market, not a fixed price list.
Keep a watchlist of stocks you're interested in, and get a DM when one of them makes a big move.
Some stocks pay out dividends automatically to anyone holding shares.
Track your full portfolio -- how much each stock is worth, your average cost, and both your realized and unrealized profit or loss.
Keep an eye on Market News for company announcements and bigger economic events that move prices.

sections.heading: New: Storefronts
items: Player-owned businesses can now be Storefronts instead of a plain business with no purpose of its own.
Storefront owners can stock items with their own prices and quantities, and sell directly to other players -- earnings go straight into the business's treasury.
Owners can check their storefront's sales and revenue at any time.

sections.heading: New: Lottery
items: Added a server-wide lottery -- buy tickets for a chance to win the entire pot.
The more tickets you buy, the better your odds when a winner is drawn.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A full redesign of the staff panel to make everyday tasks faster and clearer, plus a new way to manually link Roblox accounts for players Bloxlink can't verify.

sections.heading: New: Manual Account Verification
items: Added a new Account Verification page (Management and above) for linking a Discord member's Roblox account by hand, for the rare cases where Bloxlink can't verify someone.

Search for any member, then link their Roblox account by typing their username -- it looks up the real account and shows their avatar, display name, account age, and verification badge before you confirm.

The system checks for conflicts automatically -- if that Roblox account is already linked to someone else, or the member already has a different account linked, you'll get a warning before anything changes.
Linking or changing an account updates the member's server nickname and verified role automatically, so everything stays in sync.
Every link, change, and unlink is saved to a history log showing what changed, who did it, when, and why.

sections.heading: Dashboard
items: Redesigned the Dashboard with a cleaner layout and quicker access to common actions.
Added a shift leaderboard you can open right from the Dashboard.

sections.heading: HR Panel
items: Reorganized the HR Panel so related tools are grouped together and easier to find.
Fixed a layout bug where the LOA History card could overflow past the edge of the page on certain screen sizes.

sections.heading: Internal Affairs
items: Simplified the Internal Affairs page so issuing strikes and suggesting promotions or demotions takes fewer steps.

sections.heading: Super Admin
items: Reorganized the Super Admin page into clear tabs instead of one long scrolling page.

sections.heading: Login
items: Refreshed the login page with a cleaner, more polished look.

sections.heading: General
items: Improved spacing, sizing, and alignment across the panel so pages feel more consistent from one to the next.
The panel now works better on tablets and phones across the redesigned pages.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A new Changelog page for the staff panel, plus a full redesign of its navigation.

sections.heading: New Changelog Page
items: Added a Changelog page to the staff panel, right from the sidebar -- browse every past update and click into the full details.
From now on, every update posts here on the site and in this channel at the same time.

sections.heading: Staff Panel Refresh
items: Completely redesigned the sidebar navigation with a cleaner look and smoother animations.
Added a proper profile section at the bottom showing your avatar, name, and rank.
Fixed the sidebar being cut off and hard to use on phones -- it now slides open like a proper menu instead.
Fixed some pages not being centered correctly on wider screens.
The panel now uses the real Texas State RP logo instead of a placeholder.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A major update covering moderation, the Department Hub, staff onboarding, and a brand new player economy.

sections.heading: Keeping the Server Safe
items: The bot now automatically catches and handles raids (a flood of new members joining at once) and message spam, without staff needing to step in.

Added a Ban Review queue in Discord for Internal Affairs and above -- staff can review a submitted ban request and accept, decline, or skip it right from Discord, and accepting it bans the player immediately.
Tightened up who's allowed to use tickets and issue strikes.

sections.heading: Department Hub & Staff Info
items: Fixed the Department Hub showing old, outdated info after it had already been updated.
Refreshed the Staff Handbook and added a new Staff Info section with a striking system reference.
Removed the "Cuff Rushing" rule.

sections.heading: A Whole New Economy
items: Banking -- deposit, withdraw, and earn daily interest on your savings.
Taxes -- personal and business taxes now apply automatically.
Loans -- borrow money with a credit limit based on how active you are, and pay it back over time.
Investments -- buy into someone else's business and earn a share of its profits.
Property -- buy houses, apartments, mansions, and vehicles, each with its own upkeep cost.
Items -- buy collectible items from the shop.
Marketplace -- buy and sell items directly with other players.
Contracts -- create a formal IOU with another player that tracks what they owe until it's paid off.
Typing out an exact business, property, or listing name is no longer required -- everything now suggests matches as you type.

sections.heading: Fixes & Improvements
items: Fixed department playtime counting time when the server or bot was actually down.
Fixed ban submissions sometimes showing "user ID unknown."
Off-duty warnings no longer trigger from harmless commands.
Sending a message to multiple people at once now actually reaches everyone, not just the first person.
Leaderboards and other list-style messages no longer ping everyone shown in them.
Added an Unban option to punishment logs.
Fixed the staff panel showing a 404 error on refresh.

title: TSRP Staff System
summary: The bot and the staff panel are now fully connected. Anything you do in one shows up in the other instantly, so there's no more guessing if something actually went through.

sections.heading: Logging In
items: You log into the panel with your Discord account. Your permissions are pulled straight from your current rank, so there's nothing to set up manually.

sections.heading: Dashboard
items: Start/pause/end your shift with a live timer
See who's currently on duty and who's on break
Shift leaderboard and your full personal shift history
Live, searchable in-game player list
Log punishments (Warning, Kick, Ban, Temp Ban, BOLO, Note) with username autofill
Live activity feed (joins, leaves, kills, commands, mod/emergency calls)

sections.heading: HR Panel (Management+)
items: Run in-game commands
Issue/remove strikes, with a live strike board (3 strikes triggers auto action)
Instant promote/demote
Review pending rank change requests
Terminate staff
Process resignations (Director only)
Manage LOAs (approve, extend, end early, view history)

sections.heading: IA Panel (IA+)
items: Request backup on duty
Issue strikes on anyone regardless of rank
Suggest rank changes

sections.heading: Bot Commands
items: Everything from the panel also works in Discord: /shift, /loa, /endloa, /strike, /unstrike, /rankChange, /terminate, /resign, /runcommand, /callstaff, /players, /status, /activitycheck, /passtraining, /failtraining, /feedback, /fixnick, /say, /startup, /shutdown, plus full ticket commands (/tclose, /tadd, /tremove, /ttranscript, etc).

sections.heading: Automatic Stuff
items: Nicknames update on their own based on your duty status and rank
Off-duty command use gets flagged
Booster perks granted/removed automatically
Live status card and voice channel stats
Everything logs to one central audit channel
